correctness.rationale: For a primitive period-two orbit, displacements sum to x0/(epsilon+sqrt(v0))=-x1/(epsilon+sqrt(v1)), and memory difference (1+beta)(v1-v0)=(1-beta)a²(x0²-x1²). Unequal spatial magnitudes contradict displacement ordering; hence antipodal equal-memory orbit q=h/2-epsilon/a>0, v=a²q² is unique. Reflection S conjugates the two Jacobians; K=S Jplus has trace 1+beta, det d=2-beta-4(1-beta)epsilon/(ah), and monodromy K². Exact Jury conditions reduce to d<1, equivalent h<4epsilon/a. Discriminant vanishes uniquely at h_nf=16epsilon/[a(7+beta)], distinguishing positive real roots from complex conjugates. At equality h=4epsilon/a unit-circle crossing transversal, nonlinear boundary dynamics not asserted. Independently rederived K determinant and discriminant in symbolic algebra and bounded test cases.
